import builtins
builtins.pc_fails('policy.load', 'the scene has no robot', path='${out}/go2.bin')

import builtins
B = builtins
s = app.actions.run('policy.load', path='${out}/go2.bin')
assert s['loaded'] and s['contract'] == '' and s['roots'] == [0], s
B.pc_names = [j['name'] for j in s['joints']]
B.pc_dt = round(1.0 / (s['rate_hz'] * s['decimation']), 6)
app.policy.unload()
print('CONTRACT_SCENE', B.pc_names, B.pc_dt)
names, dt, out = B.pc_names[::-1], B.pc_dt, '${out}'
for stem, obs, act, over in (('term', 135, 12, dict(terms=[{'name': 'height_scan', 'dims': 3, 'scale': 1.0}])), ('dt', 135, 12, dict(dt=dt * 2.0)), ('joint', 135, 12, dict(joints=names[:-1] + ['nope_joint'])), ('obs', 100, 12, {}), ('act', 135, 6, {}), ('lists', 135, 12, dict(stiffness=[30.0] * 11)), ('dims', 135, 12, dict(terms=[{'name': 'joint_pos_rel', 'dims': 11, 'scale': 1.0}]))):
    B.pc_nkml(f'{out}/{stem}.nkml', obs, act, 7)
    B.pc_contract(f'{out}/{stem}', over.pop('joints', names), over.pop('dt', dt), **over)
B.pc_nkml(f'{out}/broken.nkml', 135, 12, 7)
with open(f'{out}/broken.contract.json', 'w') as f:
    f.write('{')
f = B.pc_fails
f('policy.load', "the contract's term 'height_scan' is not one the editor builds", path=f'{out}/term.nkml')
f('policy.load', 's step; the scene steps every', path=f'{out}/dt.nkml')
f('policy.load', 'no robot has all 12 joints of the contract', path=f'{out}/joint.nkml')
f('policy.load', 'the policy observes 100 values; its contract builds 135', path=f'{out}/obs.nkml')
f('policy.load', 'the policy has 6 actions; its contract drives 12 joints', path=f'{out}/act.nkml')
f('policy.load', "the contract's joint lists differ in length", path=f'{out}/lists.nkml')
f('policy.load', "the contract's joint_pos_rel has 11 values; the runner builds 12", path=f'{out}/dims.nkml')
f('policy.load', 'cannot read the contract', path=f'{out}/broken.nkml')
s = app.policy.status()
assert not s['loaded'] and 'cannot read the contract' in s['error'], s
B.pc_net = B.pc_nkml(f'{out}/good.nkml', 135, 12, 11)
B.pc_c = B.pc_contract(f'{out}/good', names, dt)

import builtins, numpy as np
B = builtins
s, c = ${p0}, B.pc_c
print('CONTRACT_POLICY', {k: v for k, v in s.items() if k not in ('joints', 'arrows')})
assert s['loaded'] and s['device'] == 'host' and s['contract'].endswith('good.contract.json'), s
assert s['robots'] == 1 and s['obs_dim'] == 135 and s['act_dim'] == 12 and s['decimation'] == 4 and s['roots'] == [0], s
assert [j['name'] for j in s['joints']] == c['joints'], s['joints']
assert np.allclose([j['default'] for j in s['joints']], c['default']), s['joints']
B.pc_links = np.array([j['link'] for j in s['joints']])
st0 = B.pc_state()
B.pc_step(1)
F = __import__('nuka').Field
links = B.pc_links
for fld, want in ((F.DRIVE_STIFFNESS, 30.0), (F.DRIVE_DAMPING, 0.7), (F.DRIVE_FORCE_LIMIT, 20.0)):
    assert np.allclose(B.pc_field(fld)[links], want), (fld, B.pc_field(fld)[links])
f0 = B.pc_frame(st0, np.zeros(12), c, links, 0, (0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
a0 = B.pc_forward(B.pc_net, B.pc_assemble([f0, f0, f0]))
tg = B.pc_field(F.DRIVE_TARGET)[links]
err0 = np.abs(tg - (np.asarray(c['default']) + 0.25 * a0)).max()
B.pc_step(3)
st1 = B.pc_state()
B.pc_step(1)
f1 = B.pc_frame(st1, a0, c, links, 0, (0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
a1 = B.pc_forward(B.pc_net, B.pc_assemble([f0, f0, f1]))
tg = B.pc_field(F.DRIVE_TARGET)[links]
err1 = np.abs(tg - (np.asarray(c['default']) + 0.25 * a1)).max()
print('CONTRACT_GOLDEN', err0, err1, np.round(a1, 3).tolist())
assert err0 < 2e-4 and err1 < 2e-4 and np.abs(a1 - a0).max() > 1e-3, (err0, err1)

import builtins, numpy as np
s = app.policy.status()
a = s['arrows']
z = builtins.pc_field(__import__('nuka').Field.ARTICULATION_LINK_POSE)[2]
print('CONTRACT_ARROWS', s['arrows_on'], a)
assert s['arrows_on'] and len(a) == 1 and a[0]['at'][2] > z + 0.3 and np.allclose(a[0]['command'], 0.0), (a, z)
s = app.actions.run('policy.arrows', on=False)
assert not s['arrows_on'] and s['arrows'] == [], s
s = app.actions.run('policy.arrows')
assert s['arrows_on'], s
builtins.pc_step(2)
assert len(app.policy.status()['arrows']) == 1

import builtins, numpy as np
app.actions.run('sim.play')
t = builtins.pc_tick()
while builtins.pc_tick() < t + 60:
    app.update(True)
app.actions.run('sim.pause')
builtins.pc_frames(10)
s = app.policy.status()
t = app.teleop.status()
cmd, a = s['command'], s['arrows'][0]
print('CONTRACT_CMD', cmd, t['command'], a)
assert t['controller'] and np.allclose(cmd, t['command'], atol=1e-6) and np.hypot(cmd[0], cmd[1]) > 0.1, (cmd, t)
assert abs(np.hypot(*a['command'][:2]) - np.hypot(cmd[0], cmd[1])) < 1e-4 and s['action_norm'] > 0.0, (a, cmd)

s = app.policy.unload()
assert not s['loaded'] and s['path'] == '' and 'arrows' not in s, s
